title: Extract the scanner from the CLI
description:
Purpose: The scanner is a library. The CLI is how people run it and upload a diagram. Split them so programmatic scan, regression tests, and the evaluation framework live in one project we can improve without CLI, quota, or upload noise.

New repo (assumed): DataParade-io/dataparade-scanner
Package (assumed): @dataparade/scanner
Public API: scan(config) -> ScanResult, plus createDefaultScanConfiguration.

Moves first: ingest, analyzers, patterns YAML, classifier, data-flow, core pipeline (structural path), graph mapping, tests/unit for those, tests/eval, tests/benchmark, Plexus-facing eval features.

Stays in the CLI: commander, config/env, writing dataflow.json, upload, platform API, quota, telemetry, Sentry.

Second cut, not this initiative: AI enrichment and LangSmith tracing stay in the CLI until the library API is stable.

Four-layer eval (KDATAP-0dbc61) follows the eval harness into the scanner project.

Exclusions: do not merge to main; do not accept gold; do not use --local / a second Kanbus board.

Definition of done: scanner project exists, CLI depends on it, in-tree engine copy is gone, eval and corpus run from the scanner project.
